tailoring.headline: Senior Software Engineer - eCommerce | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring & OCC APIs
tailoring.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of enterprise eCommerce experience building, extending, and supporting scalable e-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, and Spring Boot. Proven track record delivering robust OCC RESTful APIs, headless architecture, and data integrations across complex enterprise systems for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Experienced with cloud deployments, microservices patterns, SQL query performance tuning, and agile delivery.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer - eCommerce (m/f/d)
cover_en.hook: PAYBACK's scale and central position in digital commerce demand resilient, high-throughput backend services and frictionless partner integrations. With over five years of enterprise software engineering experience building and optimizing large-scale e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep hands-on expertise in Java, Spring, and API architecture to your Berlin team.

bullets.label: Scalable eCommerce & Headless APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless commerce APIs for web and third-party consumers, customizing interceptors, populators, and converters for clean data exchange.

bullets.label: Enterprise Backend Engineering
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend architecture across SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot, strictly following enterprise design patterns and data modeling best practices.

bullets.label: Data Integration & System Reliability
bullets.text: Engineered complex data pipelines integrating ERP, MDM, and PIM systems via DataHub and Hotfolders, resolving cross-platform integration bottlenecks alongside international technical teams.

bullets.label: Performance & Agile Delivery
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring to reduce response latency and improve transaction throughput, while conducting rigorous code reviews, mentoring junior engineers, and executing CI/CD release cycles on CCv2.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit requiring no sponsorship, I am serving my notice period until 15 December 2026 and available to start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my backend and e-commerce engineering experience can contribute to PAYBACK.

tailoring.why_company: PAYBACK stands out as Germany's leading multiparticipant loyalty platform, handling massive transactional volumes and connecting millions of users with top-tier retail partners. Building reliable, high-performance eCommerce systems at this scale is exactly where my backend engineering experience in Java, Spring, and high-availability API design can drive real business impact while tackling complex architectural challenges.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to apply my 5+ years of enterprise eCommerce backend engineering with Java, Spring, and high-traffic APIs to PAYBACK's high-scale digital ecosystem, building robust services that deliver seamless shopping experiences to millions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I noticed the Senior Software Engineer - eCommerce role at PAYBACK. With 5+ years building scalable Java/Spring backend services and headless e-commerce APIs for Shell and Rockwell Automation, I would love to connect and discuss how I can contribute to your Berlin team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer - eCommerce (m/f/d) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Software Engineer - eCommerce (m/f/d) position at PAYBACK in Berlin.

With over five years of experience building and extending enterprise e-commerce platforms using Java, Spring, and headless RESTful APIs, I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my technical background matches your team's needs.

Thank you for your time and consideration.
